set.body:
As of `fix/220-empty-contrast-table`, `write_results.fmri_lm()` retains outputs
that were written successfully when the contrast stage fails, then re-raises:

    "Failed to write BIDS contrast results: <cause> The other requested outputs
     were written and retained: <files>."

It is a plain `simpleError`, so a caller can only distinguish "contrasts failed
but the betas are on disk" from a total write failure by matching the message
string.

For batch pipelines this is the difference between usable and not: a SLURM
wrapper that wants to proceed on betas alone, or to decide whether an `afterok`
dependent should still run, has to grep the message today.

Proposal: signal a classed condition, e.g.

    fmrireg_partial_write_error < fmrireg_write_error < error

carrying the cause, the retained file paths, and which stage failed, so callers
can `tryCatch(fmrireg_partial_write_error = ...)`.

Deliberately left out of the #220 fix: it is an API surface decision, not a bug
fix. Worth deciding alongside whether `.write_beta_outputs()` failures should
carry the same class.
set.title: Give write_results() partial-write failures a classed condition
